name: markdown-rag-chunker
title: Markdown RAG Chunker: Document Text Splitter
description: RAG chunking for PDFs, Word, PowerPoint, Excel, EPUB and web pages. A header-aware text splitter keeps each chunk inside one section, caps it at 512 tokens by default, and adds its header path, source, stable ID and exact token count. Ready to embed into Pinecone, Qdrant or pgvector.
